Daily Mirror • 2026-10-23

NDB reports ongoing recoveries and control improvements after Rs. 13.64bn fraud

Supervisory focus
Key Banking Supervisory
What happened

NDB said it is pursuing recoveries and legal or internal action after the fraud identified earlier in 2026. Its latest disclosure refers to a final forensic assessment of approximately Rs. 13.64 billion and describes continuing controls, technology and governance improvements. The disclosure does not quantify actual recoveries or provide a completion timetable.

Why it matters

Direct relevance to fraud losses, remedial controls, governance and the supervisory investigation of NDB.

Sri Lanka CERT warns of fake bank gift message targeting customer credentials

Supervisory focus
Fraud and Cyber Risk
What happened

Sri Lanka CERT warned that a purported Vap Poya reward offer attributed to an unnamed major bank is fraudulent. The warning says the circulating message may be designed to steal personal or banking credentials and compromise accounts. Customers were advised to avoid its links and verify promotions through official channels.

Why it matters

Bank-impersonation fraud, phishing exposure and customer-protection risks.

The Morning • 2026-10-26

Government agencies directed to remedy PHP vulnerabilities identified by CERT

Supervisory focus
Key Banking Supervisory
What happened

The Ministry of Digital Economy directed government institutions to take corrective action over two PHP vulnerabilities identified by Sri Lanka CERT. The instruction includes checking affected installations, applying security updates, inspecting logs and restricting internet exposure where systems cannot be patched. This is a follow-up government directive to an earlier CERT advisory, not a reported breach at a bank.

Why it matters

Operational and third-party technology risk relevant to the financial sector; no confirmed bank compromise is reported.
